title: Chapter 131 High Temperature Poison
content:
Chapter 131 High Temperature Poison

Under the impact of the terrifying rat tide, the killing efficiency of the traditional Zerg defense mode decreased, which meant that the rat tide would soon rush to the front of the Zerg defense buildings.

Under the fungal blanket of the first line of defense of the Zerg base, there were a large number of Zerg puppies lurking. This time Wu Qing did not let them out.

The universal dog sea tactics can cope with the current situation, but the Zerg puppies themselves will also suffer casualties. Now there is a better defense method, so there is no need to let the puppies make fearless sacrifices.

Among the large number of defensive spikes in the first line of defense of the Zerg base, there are evenly distributed air defense towers. Originally, these air defense towers only occasionally fired a spike to hit the dense targets within a good range of fire, and they were not the main force of defense.

Now Wu Qing gave an order, and all the air defense towers switched to the splash decomposition attack mode. Their huge nozzles sprayed dot-shaped Zerg biological decomposition liquid at the dense rat group.

A large mass of Zerg biodegradation liquid was sprayed by the air defense tower to the sky above the most densely populated rat swarm in the distance, exploding into a large amount of rain-like liquid that fell rapidly and hit the rat swarm below. These rain-like liquids could cover a large area of rat tide.

"Squeak...!"

Countless sharp screams of rats rang out, and the flesh-eating Zerg biodegradation liquid hit the flesh and blood of the rats, and their small bodies melted at a speed visible to the naked eye!

When their vital parts came into contact with the liquid sprayed by the Zerg, they immediately turned into light and disappeared!

The Zerg biodegradation liquid that killed them would not disappear, but would fall on the rats below them, continuing to cause great damage to their companions!

Killing these little rats with flesh and blood, even if it was just a small drop of Zerg biodegradation liquid, its own consumption was very small, and they would eventually kill all the rats below and fall on the Zerg fungal blanket.

The Zerg's biodegradable liquid has no effect on the Zerg's organic matter. The biodegradable liquid that falls on the fungal carpet is either stepped on by the later rats or carried into the air by the ground spikes and falls back on the rats' bodies, causing continuous damage to the rats.

They will not stop this endless cycle of killing until they are exhausted.

This killing mode is really suitable for dealing with targets like rats.

Each air defense tower sprayed several mouthfuls of biodegradable liquid at different locations of the rat tide. This air point splash attack mode can quickly cover the entire battlefield.

The originally unstoppable rat tide disappeared quickly at a speed visible to the naked eye under the terrifying power of the Zerg's biodegradable liquid!

The rat tide, which has insufficient individual defense capabilities and relies solely on the attack mode of numbers, disintegrated under the Zerg's splash decomposition attack.

The Zerg Hydralisk has not yet been used, and the rat tide is a bit overwhelmed by the attack of the defense building air defense tower.

However, since these rats have come, it is impossible for them to retreat. Knowing that they are going to die, they still rush forward continuously. Even if they consume more Zerg biodegradable fluid, it can be regarded as waste utilization.

However, as a defensive building, the air defense tower is connected to the entire Zerg territory. The biodegradable fluid they store far exceeds that of the hydralisk, and the regeneration speed of the biodegradable fluid can also keep up with this consumption.

It is wishful thinking to rely on the rat tide to consume the Zerg's biodegradable fluid!

Seeing that the rat tide did not work, the clever enemy sent out a new underground ratman.

This is a kind of underground ratman with a body size not much different from that of humans. Compared with their own race, their bodies are very tall and strong.

They hold very special throwing tools in their hands and carry a large basket on their backs. This is a long-range attack unit.

After they gather to a certain number, they follow the rat tide to the Zerg base and stop when they are close to the attack range of the Zerg defense building.

They took out a green, round object from the basket behind them, put it on the throwing tool, and then threw the green ball in the direction of the Zerg base in an exaggerated throwing posture.

Although their throwing posture is exaggerated, they can indeed throw things to a long distance, with a range far exceeding the stone throwing of the bear elite soldiers, and not far from the attack distance of the Zerg defense buildings and hydralisks.

The green ball flew high and landed on the fungal carpet in front of the first line of defense of the Zerg base.

The cracking sound continued to sound, the green ball broke apart, and the green liquid inside splashed out, instantly igniting a blazing green flame, accompanied by billowing green smoke!

The Zerg immediately felt the characteristics of this green flame, high temperature aggravated the poison!

The Zerg fungal carpet kept wriggling under this attack, consuming energy to rapidly proliferate and resist the invasion of high temperature.

As for the highly toxic, it is ineffective against the Zerg.

"My Zerg attack is a long-range attack with splash decomposition, and you attack with a long-range high-temperature and highly toxic attack?"

Wu Qing felt that this high-temperature poisonous flame was the strongest long-range attack that the Zerg had encountered in this world, and the damage to the Zerg was even stronger than the corrosive mucus of the giant ghoul.

The green liquid burned for a while and then gradually went out, leaving only poisonous smoke like fog that could not be dispersed for a while.

The fungal blanket damaged by high temperature quickly proliferated and repaired, and quickly returned to normal.

The underground ratmen who threw the green ball tested the farthest position they could attack and found that they could not cause effective damage to the Zerg base at their current position, but if they went a little further, they would be hit by the Zerg from the ground and in the air.

Some of them tried to move forward and were immediately attacked by spikes from Zerg ground spikes and air defense towers. The attacks from ground spikes were easy to deal with, as there was a thick layer of rats under their feet, which greatly reduced the attack capability of ground spikes.

But the thick spikes fired by the air defense tower could kill them with one shot!

An underground ratman thrower was attacked by the powerful armor-piercing spikes from the air defense tower, his strong body was pierced, and a big hole was broken in the basket on his back.

The green balls stored in the basket broke and burst into flames with a bang, and continued to explode. In an instant, a large area of rats was burned out, and the killing efficiency was much higher than that of the Zerg!

Faced with the green poisonous smoke that gathered but did not disperse, the resistance of rats seemed to be very high, and the impact was not very great.

"Aren't these just walking gas tanks?"

Seeing this result, Wu Qing was a little happy. The range advantage of the Zerg long-range units did solve many problems.

However, for the enemy, this loss was insignificant. The explosions just cleared the surrounding rats. The underground rat throwers following behind suddenly accelerated and rushed to the attack range of the Zerg defense line at a rapid speed.

Most of them were attacked by the Zerg ground spikes and spikes, and either disappeared in light or exploded and burned.

Only a few lucky ones threw the green balls in their hands. Some Zerg hydralisks fired at the green balls that were not flying very fast in the air, and successfully exploded some of them in the air, leaving only two green balls that fell on the defensive ground spikes.

The green fire that burned instantly caused damage to the defensive ground spikes.

However, compared with the size of the defensive ground spikes, this damage was nothing, and it would not take long for it to heal itself.
